evidence.description: Published PR #28 exact-head CI: 537 tests, types, export. Does not run the larger local acceptance suite.
Fresh advanced local suite: 3040 pass, 4 fail, 3 skipped. Dirty source identified by manifest and unchanged hashes.
Fresh clean editor prototype suite: 2895 pass, 1 fail.
Local e2dff96: 548 passing checks. Not published.
36 runtime comparisons to the original numerical tables; new-campaign and elite-contract probes.
All 87 local parity requirements and historical claims preserved. Not fresh visual acceptance.
Cross-branch conflicts, limitations, failed routes and closure conditions.

Existing encounter identities: actual placement, local recruitment, daily relocation, loaded-scene protection and active saves; 549 passing tests, types and build. New world identities and civilian condition remain outside this delivery.

Retiro-only startup, free version-2 character, actual hire arrival, pesos and all contract terms, resume/import, and real first hired-squad conquest with casualties and save/reentry. Complete fresh campaign routes and balance remain unverified.

Existing residents retain injuries and death across tactical actions, active saves, exact-cell relocation, recruitment and dismissal. Finite medical supplies, paid replenishment, mission identity and local consequences are covered. New NPC identities, inventory, custody and successors remain open.

New world residents are created in the editor and encountered in the real campaign, with local recruitment policy, greetings, placement, wounds, death, progression, dismissal and saved identity. Inventory, custody, paid local contracts and successors remain open.

Civilian and active military death activate a distinct authored resident once, with saved delay/destination, scene protection and chained successors. Mounted editor and save rejection checks pass. Does not transfer campaign roles or goods.

Mounted game-page tools synchronize campaign time, finite supplies, civilian death and successor schedules with active autosaves. Consecutive calls, UI controls, stale results, invalid orders and standalone combat are covered. Does not establish browser protocol compatibility, player-known projection or full campaign acceptance.

Authored world residents offer local day, week or month service with visible prices. Real conversation, payment, wounds, deferred expiry, return, renewal, rehire and save rejection pass. Bulletin candidates remain separate. Does not establish NPC belongings, custody or a full campaign route.

New resident text graphs are authored in the mounted editor, followed through actual local conversations and preserved across saves and service changes. The mounted game rejects stale choice clicks. Does not add conditions, quest effects, rewards or historical role overrides.

Authored choices require campaign day, pesos, locality control or character state. Actual time, purchases, civilian death, editor authoring and mounted game visibility pass; unavailable choices are rejected again by the campaign. Locality control and deployed casualties also use explicitly prepared save-admitted fixtures. Does not establish quest effects or full campaign acceptance.

One-time dialogue payments and rewards use actual local conversations, funds and persistent per-choice receipts. Mounted editor/game controls, loops, saves, service changes, separate identities and rejection checks pass. A prepared treasury ceiling covers overflow. Does not establish item rewards, quest state or complete campaign acceptance.

Editor-authored quests start and resolve through actual resident dialogue. Ordered saved transitions, quest conditions, atomic treasury effects, alternate failure, multiple participants and the mounted campaign journal pass. Does not establish item objectives, historical quest overrides, automatic failures or a complete campaign.

Optional quest deadlines use acceptance seconds and expire once during actual tactical rest, strategic wait or cell travel. Mounted editor/game controls show the limit, remaining time and saved failure. Invalid/missing expiry evidence is rejected. Does not establish automatic death/escort/item failures or a full campaign.

Authored quests require up to six living characters and fail once on confirmed civilian or military death. Actual civilian actions and a prepared compact battle with a real enemy kill verify persistence; mounted controls protect references and display the saved failure cause. Does not establish escort/item objectives or full campaign acceptance.

Actual conversations call another authored resident to a pinned local meeting point. Walking, saves, re-entry, later orders, daily relocation and death pass; prepared door layouts cover blockers, traps and shelter. Mounted editor/game controls author and run the order. Does not establish marker/arrival sequences or full campaign acceptance.

Authored dialogue requires actual conscious presence at the latest local meeting destination. Real walking, saved re-entry, quest completion and one reward pass, along with mounted authoring/game controls. Prepared alarms, incapacity and occupancy isolate physical guards. Does not add automatic arrival actions or establish a full campaign.

Actual dialogue releases another resident or the speaker from a commanded meeting, with saved routine return and atomic quest/payment effects. Later orders, once-only replay, rollback, invalid saves and mounted editor/game double-click acceptance pass. Does not add automatic choreography or prove a full campaign.

Edited blade damage, AP, reach, weight, price and images drive character equipment, actual melee/AI/interception, armory instances, tactical swaps, campaign return and saved references. Mounted editor, armory and active inventory pass. Older packages remain compatible. Does not establish complete inventory, generic troop blades, merchant rules or full campaign acceptance.

Primary and optional secondary blade selections apply to newly issued enemies and militia. Actual attacks, finite ammunition, AI hand changes, trained-militia return, primary corpse recovery and saved reentry pass. Mounted editor launches both selections; the inventory displays the authored bayonet reserve. Compact scenes do not prove full campaign or inventory parity.

Initial treasury and per-firearm player/enemy/militia cartridge allotments are pinned in content. Actual entry, attack, payment/refund, militia firing and save/reentry preserve supplies. Mounted editor and game cover authoring, launch, price and exact autosave. Does not establish broad economy, ammunition types or full campaign balance.

Authored starting control and loyalty apply once to the thirteen localities. Actual hire destinations, arrival, supply connectivity, daily income, militia eligibility, travel, exploration entry and hostile attack use the resulting state. Mounted editor and rendered desk/map show the choices. Later territorial changes use an explicitly prepared saved-state fixture; no complete campaign or alternate headquarters is accepted.

Eleven plausible headquarters choices drive actual starting location, supply, creation, purchase, workshop access, hiring, travel, peaceful entry, frontier attack and saved continuation. Existing scheduled-raid protection follows the selected base; a prepared occupation verifies defeat. Mounted editor and rendered desk/journal show the selection. Historical roles, import port, later chapters and endings remain fixed.

Four plausible import ports or disabled orders, saved seeded delivery windows, real payments, unique authored instances, equipping and active saves are covered. Occupation/blockade fixtures check delayed reception; a real same-hour naval raid now precedes delivery. Mounted editor/armory controls preserve settings, orders, disabled states and delay explanations. Physical port custody and transport remain unaccepted.

Ordered authored chapters, introduction and victory/defeat text use real paid arrival, dialogue quest completion, contract expiry, deadline and tactical death outcomes. Saves preserve pinned definitions and ordered terminal history. Mounted authoring and rendered game views are covered. Original role/world composition and a second full independent campaign remain open.

An all-authored two-person cast follows real paid arrival, exact-cell encounter, dialogue quest and saved chapter victory. Empty casts create a free officer and visit a real sector. Optional original ambient residents, absence of removed contacts, pinned saves, mounted historical copy/removal, independent local service and real march fatigue are covered. Strategic role transfer and complete world composition remain open.

Two strategic roles bind to authored character identities. Real paid arrival activates them; actual contract expiry and tactical death remove them. Exact cell/locality travel, one-time foundry/funding payments, pinned saves, mounted editor reference controls and actual treasury controls are covered. Custody and occupation checks use prepared states. Other roles, function values and full campaign composition remain open.

Authored locality, project/army names and two prices drive real preparation, funding, loyalty and repair/resupply. Paid arrival in Salta and a Jujuy workshop route save without Mendoza control. Mounted authoring and actual treasury payments are covered. Wear, occupation, supply cuts and insufficient funds use prepared states. Original Cuyo gates, tactical buildings and full campaign composition remain separate.

Completed or pending foundry/funding steps drive authored chapters, failure and dialogue eligibility. Real paid arrival, preparation, contract expiry and funding reach a saved ending; a real resident quest rejects premature rewards and completes after funding and scene settlement. Mounted authoring, undo and copying retain the shared condition. Arbitrary projects and full campaign composition remain open.

A fresh paid capital victory produced a real casualty whose contract expiry invalidated later saves. Expiry/dismissal presence is now synchronized without reviving the actor; narrowly identified old stale flags are repaired. Actual paid relief reaches a saved San Nicolas defeat, not full campaign acceptance. A separate military-body reentry defect was reproduced; its later correction is tracked by BODY-01.

Actual capital casualties retain identity, positions and finite gear through saved visits. Real ammunition/weapon recovery cannot repeat; prior deaths do not rejoin service or become new report casualties. Prepared reoccupation isolates reused enemy IDs and accounting, followed by a real second battle and saved settlement. No body restoration from already erased snapshots, custody/transport, full campaign or live-browser acceptance is claimed.

A prepared compact San Lorenzo endpoint wins through actual combat, explores, uses a finite medical dressing, recovers a weapon, saves and settles. The mounted game uses its normal victory/explore/return controls. Active enemies, missing clearance and failed combat reject victory; a commander who dies during exploration still causes defeat. This does not accept the full fresh San Lorenzo route.

Two fresh default-content seed-8 routes reach saved phase 2 through actual Buenos Aires, San Nicolas and San Lorenzo combat: a free created officer with local/paid support and a hire-only force. Paid controlled arrivals and replacements, finite medical supplies, permanent casualties, every-order clock synchronization and midpoint reload/replay are covered. Created-only unpaid play, north/Cuyo/ending, general balance and live performance remain unaccepted. PR #61 merged after CI passed at bd9ad39e6684170f543788b26afc76b1d4b8a77d.

Fresh stock mixed-force continuation from the accepted coastal route: actual Cordoba/Tucuman/Salta battles, every-order clock/replay and midpoint saves, real losses, paid workshop service and replacement arrivals, 550-peso diplomacy, physical Yatasto dialogue and saved phase 3. The original created actor dies and the campaign continues. Advanced medical/rescue failures, Cuyo/ending, other force builds and live performance remain open. PR #62 merged after CI passed at 09b9d2bed0be8d72a22d3af266f3d9009de0f712.

Fresh stock coastal/northern continuation pays fortifications, a replacement and five muskets, then wins Mendoza tactically with Beltran dead. Confirmed indispensable death now yields a saved explicit campaign defeat. Prepared compact military deaths cover assigned engineer, recruited commander, completed-project and custom-story exceptions, old-save migration and revived-save rejection; the strategic view names the cause. This is a loss route, not Cuyo or full-campaign success. PR #63 merged after CI passed at a19cc38254a1ce90164de1aef38190185cff1015.

Fresh stock mixed Retiro/coastal/northern route wins actual Mendoza/Uspallata/Los Patos with replay and midpoint saves, pays supplies, fortifications, controlled arrivals and muskets, treats/recruits the living engineer, rejects early commander recruitment, pays 3000-peso funding and three artillery pieces, then physically recruits San Martin at saved phase 4. Final victory, other forces, advanced systems, independent stories and live performance remain open. PR #64 merged after CI passed at cb8d997991cf9af9a0ab06ad447c4ac68f854941.

One untouched stock seed-8 mixed route reaches all thirteen locality victories through actual combat, paid supplies/contracts, controlled arrivals, permanent losses and original mission/project gates. Every final battle replays with campaign time and midpoint saves. Saved victory retains the living commander; 48-hour post-victory income, contract expiry and sector re-entry preserve the ending without reintroducing an expired hire. Other force builds, advanced systems, independent stories and live performance remain open. PR #65 merged after CI passed at c45127b32c074346ca8e085545dc69dfe1d9629d.

Per-character finite initial priming, flints, rations, torches, dressings and boleadoras. Mounted authoring covers undo, copy, reset, invalid launch and saved deployment. Real paid arrival and local/historical recruitment preserve zero amounts; torch consumption, renewal, dismissal, rehire and paid workshop service retain actual stocks. Civilian loot/custody and player-created officer allocations remain separate. PR #66 merged after CI passed at 51e9faf5732c019b779ebee6b551acf635568e72.

A normal authored campaign with 14 initial cartridges reproduced a stale ten-reserve save limit. Pending deployment validation now uses its pinned rule. Real exploration and combat deployments cover 0, 10, 11, 14 and 100, invalid excess reserves, paid issue/refund and duplicate settlement rejection. Actual firing, reload and active save preserve consumption with a 100-round allocation. PR #67 merged after CI passed at 1f77280fc516baede6f694233789a769a1f3a9b9.

A downloadable independent three-chapter package completes actual paid recruitment, two battles, local dialogues, replacements, workshop service, finite care, three permanent losses and the saved return ending. Replay, midpoint saves, post-victory reentry, real deadline failure, content pinning and mounted example load/edit/undo/launch are covered. One seed/strategy is accepted; stock geography/opposition and advanced integration remain separate. PR #68 merged after CI passed at 000a91ba63b9910ad892263c23474afd120dba0b.

Hired doctors and patients share an exact safe cell and spend time, energy and finite dressings. Actual campaign controls assign, advance and purchase; saves retain wounds, stocks and work. A real injured resident is recruited, treated, dismissed and encountered with recovered health. Prepared wounds are declared in the other fixtures. Advanced rest, bleeding, militia care, physical custody and northern relief remain open. PR #69 merged after CI passed at 5ac433282f4c8d8caea6ab4686c5498391f8607a.

A two-squad paid-hire route reproduced remote repair and replenishment. Shared workshop eligibility now checks the recipient exact location, availability, control and supply. Real return travel, payment, repeat rejection, saves, deployment and mounted armory controls pass. Wear is a declared prepared fixture; timed repair, stock custody and armory transfers remain separate.

Explicit rest and waiting patients recover energy and fatigue during safe campaign hours. Stable rest wounds recover once per six continuous hours; saves retain partial time and changes cannot grant health. Exhausted care, actual physician work/rest, remote squad travel, contract expiry, occupation, invalid saves and mounted controls pass. Automatic sleep, collapse, global energy capacity and advanced route parity remain open.

Nine optional pinned settings control actual medical eligibility, healing, effort, rest progress and dressing prices across bulk purchase and workshop refill. Old identities/defaults, strict validation, custom and zero values, saved intervals, finite costs and mounted editor undo/reset/launch pass. Prepared wounds/stocks are declared; arbitrary balance and advanced care remain separate.

A full diary reproduces an 81-entry invalid save on essential civilian death. The fix preserves the newest 80 entries, active save/load, once-only death acknowledgement, departure and permanent defeat. Prepared chapter/diary; real fatal orders. 834 passing tests, types, build and baseline checks.

Finite skill-based manual stabilization, ordinary bandaging without health gain, persistent bandaged wounds, civilian/recruit continuity, actual mouse/keyboard controls and valid saves. Fresh stock and independent campaigns retain paid supplies, replacements, elapsed time and permanent loss. 844 passing tests, types, export and baseline checks; no full advanced or browser-performance claim.

Authored living initial health, energy, fatigue, bleeding and bandaged wounds are validated and assigned once. Actual paid arrival, rest, rehire, critical resident stabilization, purchased strategic care, civilian return, unattended bleed death and mounted editor copy/reset/launch preserve condition and pinned content. 849 passing tests, types, export and baseline checks; no initial death, unloaded bleeding or advanced-care claim.

Shared critical-health and exhaustion incapacity, zero action budgets, finite stabilization without immediate AP, actual wound speech, battle settlement and saved enemy casualties with finite looting. Paid-hire and prepared-boundary checks, mounted controls and fresh campaign regression retain real care, losses, defense and costs. 854 passing tests, zero failures/skips, types, export and baseline checks; advanced condition, custody and browser performance remain separate.

Loaded civilian phases recover finite capped energy after the movement opportunity. Actual harm, critical wounds, corpses, departed actors, split saved cadence and finite aid retain their boundaries. A content-authored exhausted resident wakes through ordinary sector time, converses, joins and returns with its recovered energy while unloaded time grants nothing. 858 passing tests, zero failures/skips, types, export and baseline checks; full fatigue, unloaded simulation and browser performance remain separate.

Six new physical character states drive authored dialogue and campaign conditions. Actual finite rescue, current deployed and mission-ally health, saved state, earned maximum health, editor undo/copy/pinning and actual enemy damage are covered. Validated tactical checkpoints resolve health failures; stale service sheets cannot satisfy deployed physical queries. 865 passing tests, zero failures/skips, types, export and baseline checks; automatic speech/rewards and complete advanced integration remain separate.

Optional authored first-aid responses follow actual finite care for another conscious person. Paid military and resident routes, invalid and silent cases, civilian recovery timing, saved voice integrity and editor undo/copy/pinned launch are covered. 871 passing tests, zero failures/skips, types, export and baseline checks; physical inventory and complete medical integration remain separate.

Fresh default campaign with a legal free officer and only physically recruited Cabral, Dorrego and Paroissien reaches saved San Lorenzo completion. Actual gear purchases, 19 hours of finite care, paid dressings, rest, permanent deaths, tactical replay and continued saved visit are covered. 872 passing tests, zero failures/skips, types, export and baseline checks; this does not claim solo or all-seed balance or the separate advanced route fixes.

Six finite personal supply quantities belong to the resident identity. Actual collection, partial transfers, critical aid, daily movement, recruitment, return, death succession, named ally consumption, legacy admission and pointer/keyboard controls are covered. 879 passing tests with zero failures/skips, types, production export and all 36 baseline checks; complete equipment, inventory and custody remain open.

queue.action: Preserve the accepted fresh mixed published historical route and post-victory continuation. Preserve the accepted independent post campaign, verify remaining force starts and broader authored composition; diagnose each advanced medical, recapture and prisoner-rescue failure. Import advanced systems with their tests and approved pesos/contract policies one capability at a time; do not replace the reducer wholesale.
Extend world identities, health and successor activation into belongings, custody and explicit role/stock transfer, as separate deliveries.

Extend conditional dialogue and shared quest states with item/objective and historical role effects; extend local meetings with markers and arrival sequences, and deliver rules, equipment/merchants and portable content one feature at a time.
Close remaining parity and presentation gaps. Finish both the stock and independently authored campaigns and the release audit.

requirements.requirement: Keep finite resident supplies through collection, movement and service
requirements.published: The six personal supply quantities come from each resident identity. Paid adjacent collection from a body or unconscious resident reduces its stock; ordinary movement, service changes and saves retain the remainder. A successor keeps its separate allocation.
requirements.local: Six simulations cover actual collection and finite aid, daily relocation, local recruitment and dismissal, actual death and successor, rejected/partial/capped transfers, older saves and actual named ally ration use. Mounted pointer and keyboard collection preserves quantities and reports them. A formerly collected resident entering the actual allied role also keeps its empty stock. The initial broad run reached historical victory but found an outdated treasury expectation: actual replenishment costs 86 pesos. The final corrected release source passes 879 tests with zero failures/skips; types, production export and all 36 baseline checks pass.
requirements.acceptance: Author finite resident supplies, collect and spend them through actual orders, save and relocate, then recruit and return without replenishment. Confirm death, retain the empty body and activate a distinct successor with its own stock.

requirements.requirement: Complete a fresh coastal opening with the created officer and local recruits only
requirements.published: A legal free officer and actual local encounters complete Buenos Aires, San Nicolás and San Lorenzo without bulletin hires, preserving paid preparation, finite care and permanent losses. Merged through PR #80 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Three opening routes pass; the local force pays 230 pesos for its first musket, 920 for later muskets, 27 for workshop service and 180 for 18 dressings. Nineteen care hours and six hours of rest precede the remaining victories and saved hour-80 continuation.
requirements.acceptance: Start with Retiro and no people, create the free officer, recruit only actual residents, pay normal equipment and treatment costs, win through ordinary orders and preserve all deaths and wounds through save/replay and continued play.

requirements.requirement: Author conscious patient responses to actual first aid
requirements.published: A living conscious patient can speak an optional authored line after another person spends a dressing on actual tactical care. Loading, later recovery, self-care and invalid orders do not trigger a response. Merged through PR #79 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Five simulation cases cover strict optional content, actual paid critical military and resident care, spent supplies, saved voice, older identity, silent and rejected boundaries and civilian phase timing. A mounted editor case covers undo, duplicate, clear and pinned launch.
requirements.acceptance: Author a response, stabilize an actual critical patient through finite care and saved continuation, speak on consciousness and retain spent supplies without replaying speech from load or later recovery.

requirements.requirement: Author dialogue, rescue objectives and failure rules from current character health
requirements.published: Dialogue choices and campaign rules can require consciousness, unconsciousness, wounds, bleeding, stable consciousness or full health. They use current scene/identity health, while physical condition does not imply presence or service. Merged through PR #78 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Six simulations and a mounted editor case cover actual paid aid, a rescue response and chapter, current military and mission-ally queries, maximum-health growth, actual enemy damage, immediate saved failure, import and editor undo/copy/pinned launch.
requirements.acceptance: Author a response and rescue objective, apply actual finite treatment, reveal/select the branch and settle/save the objective. Query current deployed wounds and resolve an actual unconsciousness failure without using stale military health, inventing death or granting resources.

requirements.requirement: Recover exhausted world residents through actual loaded sector time
requirements.published: Living present civilians recover ten energy after each loaded civilian phase, once per complete combat round or six exploration seconds. Waking grants no same-phase movement, health, AP or cleared harm; critical wounds, dead actors and unloaded time retain their separate rules. Merged through PR #77 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Four new cases cover actual damage history, split saved time, real tactical clocks, critical/dead/departed actors, finite stabilization and an authored exhausted resident continuing through conversation, local recruitment, dismissal and saved return.
requirements.acceptance: Author a resident with zero energy; verify it is initially incapacitated, recover through actual loaded time, converse and recruit normally, then save/return without resetting energy, healing wounds or giving an unloaded grant.

requirements.requirement: Apply critical military incapacity and retain living enemy casualties across saved visits
requirements.published: Living soldiers below 15 health or with zero energy cannot act; breath recovery cannot heal critical wounds, and stabilization grants no immediate AP. Critical casualties no longer hold the field and preserve their wounds and finite belongings through reentry and new occupation. Merged through PR #76 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Five new simulation cases and existing mounted first-aid controls verify actions, breath, treatment, legacy migration and current-save rejection. Fresh campaign checks retain real replacement hires, 36 hours of paid care, purchases, later coastal defenses, permanent losses and saved continuation.
requirements.acceptance: Incapacitate through actual damage, prevent illegal actions, stabilize with finite supplies without immediate AP, save and settle the field, then revisit and loot actual finite casualty equipment without resurrection or duplication. Keep the stock and independent campaign routes playable with real resources.

requirements.requirement: Author initial character wounds, energy and fatigue without resetting later condition
requirements.published: A complete optional initial condition is authored in each character sheet and assigned once at campaign creation. Bulletin candidates remain off map until controlled arrival. Real treatment, rest, service changes and saves retain the later mutable state. Merged through PR #75 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Four simulation cases and a mounted editor case cover strict bounds, older content identity, paid arrivals, recovery and rehire, actual critical resident treatment and purchased strategic care, saved return, unknown-origin bleeding death and draft isolation.
requirements.acceptance: Create an injured resident through the editor, encounter and stabilize it with finite supplies, recruit and treat it, then dismiss/save/re-enter without resetting health; retain the same one-time policy for bulletin arrivals and legacy packages.

requirements.requirement: Stabilize critical casualties with finite field work and retain bandaged wounds
requirements.published: Manual care uses partial skill-based work toward 15 HP, spends one dressing per effective stroke and the normal AP or exploration time. Ordinary bandaging does not restore ordinary health. Bandaged wounds persist through return, recruitment, strategic recovery and saves. Merged through PR #74 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Ten new plan, simulation and mounted-control checks cover treatment, failure and persistence. The two fresh coastal routes, northern route, complete stock campaign, independent post campaign and explicit historical loss pass with actual resources and casualties.
requirements.acceptance: Apply partial care through actual controls, consume finite supplies and time, save midway, preserve stabilized and bandaged state through campaign return, and recover ordinary health only through campaign care. Reject repeated completed or unavailable work.

requirements.requirement: Save essential civilian deaths with a full campaign journal
requirements.published: Essential civilian death notices retain the newest 80 journal entries without losing the fatal state. Actual active saves, repeated acknowledgement, departure and saved defeat remain valid. Merged through PR #73 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: The new regression first reproduced 81 entries. It prepares a chapter and full diary, then uses actual paid recruitment, travel, approach and fatal orders; the existing civilian and historical loss routes remain covered.
requirements.acceptance: Fill the journal, cause an actual essential civilian death, save/reload the active scene, settle it and preserve the death, defeat and bounded once-only notice.

requirements.requirement: Author and pin medical work, rest recovery and dressing prices
requirements.published: The Rules tab accepts nine care values with bounded integers, undo and reset. Campaigns preserve them across saves and use the same dressing price for both workshop paths, including free legitimate replenishment. Merged through PR #72 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Five simulation cases and mounted authoring verify legacy identity, custom eligibility/healing/effort, long saved rest intervals, zero costs/recovery, finite stock, actual paid launch and later draft isolation.
requirements.acceptance: Edit valid and invalid care rules, launch and use them through real campaign actions, verify both dressing purchase paths and save partial recovery without rerolling or restoring stock.

requirements.requirement: Rest serving personnel and resume work through persistent strategic assignments
requirements.published: Squad controls assign explicit rest, show energy/fatigue and stop deployment until service resumes. Safe hourly recovery preserves partial stable healing; patients recover breath while waiting. Assignment changes and contract expiry grant no extra interval. Merged through PR #71 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Six simulation cases and the extended mounted medical screen cover progress, saves, stops and concurrent squad travel. The actual wounded-resident route rests its physician after paid and finite care without creating supplies.
requirements.acceptance: Spend campaign time to recover an exhausted person, save mid-rest, resume care or deployment, and reject incompatible work while preserving finite supplies and health.

requirements.requirement: Require actual local presence for paid workshop replenishment and repair
requirements.published: The selected workshop can service only a person actually present there. The armory shows the person location and blocks remote service with a reason. Explicit dressing purchases share the same eligibility. Merged through PR #70 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: A formerly accepted remote request fails in the new regression. Actual paid hires and travel, local service, return, once-only charges, saves and deployment are covered, together with mounted armory controls. Prepared wear is declared.
requirements.acceptance: Separate two serving people by real travel; reject distant service without changing state; return and pay through normal controls; retain the actual supplies and condition in saves and deployment.

requirements.requirement: Assign serving doctors and patients for finite hourly care through campaign controls
requirements.published: Doctors first stop bleeding, then restore health in the same safe controlled cell. Personal dressings and energy limit treatment; supplied local workshops sell explicit quantities. Medical assignments prevent marching or deployment and cannot overlap militia instruction. Merged through PR #69 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Six simulation checks and a mounted campaign flow cover finite care, distinct patients, remote rejection, expiry, purchase and saved continuation. An actually wounded resident retains recovery after recruitment, treatment and return to the world.
requirements.acceptance: Use actual assignment and time controls, spend finite supplies, buy replacements, save and deploy recovered personnel; reject remote care and invalid work without granting health or supplies.

requirements.requirement: Load, edit and finish a complete independent campaign package
requirements.published: La ruta de las postas is a downloadable three-chapter scenario with thirteen independent identities, paid service, two actual locality battles, world contacts, a timed objective and its own ending. The editor loads it with undo and the verified seed. Merged through PR #68 after exact-head CI. The later finite-first-aid regression completes after eight hours of paid medical work, actual weapon purchases and a daylight approach to Salta.
requirements.local: A fresh seed-8 route pays for replacements and supplies, preserves three deaths, returns to Córdoba and saves victory; a separate fresh timed route loses. Mounted controls load, edit, undo and launch real play.
requirements.acceptance: Use a portable package without engine-specific scenario code; launch and complete its declared beginning, middle and ending through actual campaign actions, with losses, costs, saved continuation and a real failure path.

requirements.requirement: Save every supported authored cartridge allocation through actual deployment
requirements.published: Pending squad reserve validation follows the pinned cartridge allowance instead of a fixed ten-round maximum. Authored allocations through 100 save in exploration and combat; out-of-range reserves remain rejected. Merged through PR #67 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: The new scenario exposed a real rejected save at 14 cartridges. Regression coverage includes zero, boundary values, paid issue/refund, finite firing/reload, active save and rejected duplicate departure.
requirements.acceptance: Launch a valid authored allowance above the old reserve cap, enter a real scene, save/reload, expend ammunition and settle once without rejecting valid quantities or replenishing spent rounds.

requirements.requirement: Author finite starting personal supplies without refilling on service changes
requirements.published: Character sheets accept six explicit integer supply counts, including zero. New campaigns allocate once; contracted arrivals and local recruitment use the saved counts. Older packages retain original defaults. Merged through PR #66 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Editor undo, redo, copy, reset, validation and launch are mounted. Real torch consumption survives save/reload, renewal, dismissal and rehire; workshop service charges for its existing targets. Historical recruitment retains zero quantities.
requirements.acceptance: Author and import valid counts; reject incomplete or unsupported allocations; recruit through normal controls, consume supplies, save, renew and rehire without duplicating them.

requirements.requirement: Finish a fresh stock historical campaign and continue after saved victory
requirements.published: The complete mixed Retiro route wins all thirteen localities without injected outcomes or resources. Real paid service, supplies, finite care, controlled arrivals and losses lead to historical victory with San Martin alive. The created actor stays dead. A 48-hour continuation receives income, expires a daily contract and re-enters the sector without restoring the former hire or repeating the ending. Merged through PR #65 after exact-head CI. The later finite-first-aid regression replays the full route with additional paid replacements, victory at hour 450 and a saved 48-hour continuation.
requirements.local: Published stock seed 8 and one strategy only. The hired-only and unpaid-only full routes, larger advanced gameplay, authored second campaign and live performance remain separate requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Run the complete fresh mixed historical campaign through actual battle settlement and original gates, replay/save the final battles, preserve casualties and real treasury costs, then save victory and continue through income, contract expiry and retained-sector re-entry.

requirements.requirement: Prepare Cuyo from a fresh campaign and physically recruit the late commander
requirements.published: The untouched stock mixed force continues through actual Cuyo combat, preserves indispensable residents, pays project/funding, treaty, artillery, fortifications, supplies and replacement contracts, then reaches phase 4 and recruits San Martin in person. Early recruitment and duplicate funding are rejected; the created actor and casualties stay dead. Merged through PR #64 after exact-head CI.
requirements.local: Every Cuyo battle replays with campaign time and midpoint save/reload. The controller avoids fire through visible civilians; the separate loss route remains valid. Published care rules only, not advanced medical parity.
requirements.acceptance: From untouched Retiro complete the coast, north and three Cuyo victories with real losses/purchases, treat and recruit the engineer, satisfy the pesos-only preparations, reject early commander service and retain actual late incorporation at saved phase 4.

requirements.requirement: End original campaigns explicitly when an unfinished indispensable role is permanently lost
requirements.published: A confirmed death of the assigned engineer before foundry completion or the historical commander before victory ends the original campaign. Check primary-blade ammunition, AI hand-change costs and recovery from knockdown, trained militia return/reentry, primary corpse loot and retreat, older and secondary-only packages, malformed entries and displayed authored bayonet reserve.

requirements.acceptance: Author valid values, undo and restore defaults; launch a real attack; verify initial funds once, free personal creation at zero, zero allocations, firearm capacity, blade exclusions, paid entry, returns, militia consumption and save/reentry; reject malformed rules and altered content. Check mounted game price, charge and exact active autosave.

Saves retain later changes.

requirements.acceptance: Validate complete territory maps and original/older defaults; author, undo and restore through editor controls; launch real arrivals, travel, sector entry, neighbor assault and daily income; check supply and militia requirements; preserve later saved ownership and reject altered pinned content; render initial/current territory accurately.
